sources.title: The Scottish Parliament — 400th Anniversary of Charles I's Accession (S6M-16963)
sources.citation_text: The Scottish Parliament motion S6M-16963 identifies Charles I as succeeding to the thrones of England, Scotland and Ireland on his father's death in March 1625. This corroborates the Scottish crown as distinct from any later unified Kingdom of Great Britain, while the 1649 execution ends his reign. The motion is historical commemoration, not proof of uninterrupted effective control during the civil wars.
